hypothesis: Distill deployed finite-budget root halving into unchanged 64x6 network; compare balanced replay with and without policy-surprise sampling.

data.selection: two uniformly sampled normal positions per game phase, without replacement; replay every game and assert features/legal masks/outcome
data.target: 0.75 halving recommendation + 0.25 clean legal NN prior; play recommendation remains unmodified
data.surprise: KL(halving recommendation || clean prior), weighted only in training within source/generation/board; half base sampling and half surprise, retain domain masses
data.split: Pinned round2 split, no promotion of old training games

training.selection: minimum normal common-target validation loss among epoch0/4/8/12/16; no match-based epoch selection

development.selection: highest score; tie prefers unweighted; require >=27/48 and no caps/illegal before holdout

strengthGate: paired 95% CI lower >0.5; each board >=12/32; no caps/illegal
speedGate: paired fixed18 roots, 2warmups7repetitions CPU/WASM+WebGPU; overallP95<=1.05 baseline and eachboard<=1.10
adoption: only adopt model if all gates pass; retain 64visits and exact deployed search; no deployment in this study
